references.context: Category whose objects are arrows H(i)→j with compatibility-preserving arrows from I
Objects of the over-comma construction, oriented toward fixed target j rather than away from it

references.phrase: nonempty and connected for all j
references.disposition: Universal quantification over the objects of J is required; one connected comma category does not suffice.

review_rationale: Read initiality using the opposite-oriented comma category (H↓j) with arrows H(i)→j for every target j; retained the connectedness requirement and contrasted this explicitly with the cofinal-functor direction.
